title: 내가 처음 고른 것
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop with City Pop and Funk influences. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated 16th-note muted scratches and rhythmic chords. A slap bass guitar performs a busy, percussive line with frequent slides and pops. The drum kit features a tight, dry snare and a crisp hi-hat playing 16th-note patterns. A bright, polyphonic synthesizer provides staccato chord stabs. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth tenor range, transitioning into a powerful, belted head voice during the chorus. The arrangement features sudden dynamic shifts and layered vocal harmonies. Key of E Major, 115 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean funk electric guitar scratches, slap bass enters with percussive pops]

[Verse 1]
[smooth tenor male vocals]
엄마가 혼자 골라왔을 때
서가 사이던 미로 같아
키가 안 닿는 선반 위에
뭔가 대단한 게 있을 것 같아서 [staccato synth stabs enter]
손가락으로 책등을 짚었어
제목은 하나도 못 읽었지만
두꺼운 건 무섭고 얇은 건 별로고
툭 표지 하나 꺼냈다
아무 이유 없었어
그냥 토끼가 웃고 있잖아
그게 내 첫 선택이었나 봐 [vocal builds in intensity]

[Chorus]
[full band, driving 16th-note hi-hats]
내가 처음 고른 건 [belted vocals]
토끼 하나였어
